decisions.name: QR-01
decisions.context: brief: Fixed acceptance cases / QR-01. QR-01: Register/login Alice and Bob; create a resource as Alice; record returned ID and persisted destination. Logout invalidates the session. Unauthenticated creation/read/update/image/activity returns 401.
decisions.decision: Future C4a/C4b binding and independent acceptance must retain this exact obligation. P11 historical acceptance is preserved source evidence, not a passing result for this new reference.
decisions.consequence: Source requirement remains unimplemented/unverified. Finite settings and this study do not supply application behavior or runtime support.

decisions.name: QR-02
decisions.context: brief: Fixed acceptance cases / QR-02. QR-02: Download the real image, record its SHA-256, decode its pixels independently, and assert its URL is the configured public origin plus `/q/{id}`. The destination URL must not be embedded.
decisions.decision: Future C4a/C4b binding and independent acceptance must retain this exact obligation. P11 historical acceptance is preserved source evidence, not a passing result for this new reference.
decisions.consequence: Source requirement remains unimplemented/unverified. Finite settings and this study do not supply application behavior or runtime support.

decisions.name: QR-03
decisions.context: brief: Fixed acceptance cases / QR-03. QR-03: Request the decoded URL without automatic redirect following, assert 302, no-store, and original Location. Follow it to destination server A and verify A received the request. Assert one event for each redirect request, counting any second request explicitly.
decisions.decision: Future C4a/C4b binding and independent acceptance must retain this exact obligation. P11 historical acceptance is preserved source evidence, not a passing result for this new reference.
decisions.consequence: Source requirement remains unimplemented/unverified. Finite settings and this study do not supply application behavior or runtime support.

decisions.name: QR-04
decisions.context: brief: Fixed acceptance cases / QR-04. QR-04: Edit destination to server B. Assert identical resource/redirect ID and byte-identical downloaded QR image. Request the original decoded URL again; assert B is reached and A is not. Verify no cached permanent redirect masks the change.
decisions.decision: Future C4a/C4b binding and independent acceptance must retain this exact obligation. P11 historical acceptance is preserved source evidence, not a passing result for this new reference.
decisions.consequence: Source requirement remains unimplemented/unverified. Finite settings and this study do not supply application behavior or runtime support.

decisions.name: QR-05
decisions.context: brief: Fixed acceptance cases / QR-05. QR-05: Make repeated requests, including from the same client; assert total increases for every redirect request. Fixed test-only clock/data fixtures spanning UTC days verify bucket boundaries, zero days, bounded date range validation, and totals. Do not expose fixture/clock controls in the production app.
decisions.decision: Future C4a/C4b binding and independent acceptance must retain this exact obligation. P11 historical acceptance is preserved source evidence, not a passing result for this new reference.
decisions.consequence: Source requirement remains unimplemented/unverified. Finite settings and this study do not supply application behavior or runtime support.

decisions.name: QR-06
decisions.context: brief: Fixed acceptance cases / QR-06. QR-06: As Bob, list/read/update/download/activity cannot see Alice's resource; ID guessing and relationship manipulation do not bypass ownership. Lists contain only the current user's resources. Rejected requests do not change destination or scans.
decisions.decision: Future C4a/C4b binding and independent acceptance must retain this exact obligation. P11 historical acceptance is preserved source evidence, not a passing result for this new reference.
decisions.consequence: Source requirement remains unimplemented/unverified. Finite settings and this study do not supply application behavior or runtime support.

decisions.name: QR-07
decisions.context: brief: Fixed acceptance cases / QR-07. QR-07: Malformed payloads, unknown fields, invalid IDs, non-HTTP URLs, credential-bearing URLs, caller-supplied owner IDs, and missing IDs return documented 400/404 responses. Unknown redirects add no event; failed unauthorized updates preserve the destination.
decisions.decision: Future C4a/C4b binding and independent acceptance must retain this exact obligation. P11 historical acceptance is preserved source evidence, not a passing result for this new reference.
decisions.consequence: Source requirement remains unimplemented/unverified. Finite settings and this study do not supply application behavior or runtime support.

decisions.name: QR-08
decisions.context: brief: Fixed acceptance cases / QR-08. QR-08: Restart the service and Postgres with the same volumes. Login again, read the saved resource, decode the image again, follow the original URL to B, and verify persisted history plus exactly the new event.
decisions.decision: Future C4a/C4b binding and independent acceptance must retain this exact obligation. P11 historical acceptance is preserved source evidence, not a passing result for this new reference.
decisions.consequence: Source requirement remains unimplemented/unverified. Finite settings and this study do not supply application behavior or runtime support.

decisions.name: QR-09
decisions.context: brief: Fixed acceptance cases / QR-09. QR-09: Drive account creation/login, resource create/edit, image download, and activity views in the browser by mouse. Check the visible totals agree with API/persisted evidence.
decisions.decision: Future C4a/C4b binding and independent acceptance must retain this exact obligation. P11 historical acceptance is preserved source evidence, not a passing result for this new reference.
decisions.consequence: Source requirement remains unimplemented/unverified. Finite settings and this study do not supply application behavior or runtime support.
